newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Beef panel buys 30,839 tonnes into intervention store.
newsitem.headline: Beef panel buys 30,839 tonnes into intervention store.

text.p: The European Union's beef management committee agreed to buy 30,839 tonnes of beef into intervention stores at a maximum price of 266 Ecus per 100 kg, a European Commission official said.
A total of 47,539 tonnes was offered.
In addition 182 tonnes of beef from young cattle of between seven and nine months old were accepted at a maximum price of 353.8 Ecus per 100 kg.
The EU has bought 396,000 tonnes of beef into intervention stores since the mad cow crisis erupted in March.
The current ceiling is 460,000 tonnes for 1996 but the Commission has proposed an increase to 720,000 tonnes.
